record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare MEDITATE: Meditite (1 star, atk 9) and Medicham (2 stars, atk 16); both maxPP 100, range 2, no passive. The strategy is shared; the difference is the unit's base attack (the buff amount scales with it). MEDITATE as an ability is distinct from EffectEnum.MEDITATE, the HUMAN synergy tier-1 effect (see routing).

dispatch.registry: AbilityStrategies[Ability.MEDITATE] = meditateStrategy (exported constant instance of the unexported class MeditateStrategy)

record.summary: Needs no target and deals no damage. The caster raises its own attack by its baseAtk (the attack it had when the combat entity was created), scaled by (1 + AP/100) and by its critPower if the cast crits, rounded, then adjusted by its own Big Eater Belt if held, and added to its current attack (attack cannot fall below 1). Meditite requests +9 (baseAtk 9), Medicham +16 (baseAtk 16) before AP, crit and held items. The change is not temporary in code: addAttack has no timer and permanent is false, so it lasts for the combat only, and each cast adds again.

targeting.note: requiresTarget = false, so process runs with target null; the buff is applied to the casting entity itself (caster and receiver are the same).

effects.scaling: requested = 1 x baseAtk (Meditite 9, Medicham 16 if the entity's initial atk equals the class value; not verified for per-run modifiers). Applied by addAttack with apBoost 1: round(requested x (1 + caster AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit)); then the caster's Big Eater Belt (x1.25, rounded down to 0 digits) if held; Twist Band does not change a positive self-buff; final atk = max(1, atk + applied).
effects.resolution: requested (baseAtk) -> applied (after AP, crit, belt) -> new atk (clamped at 1 minimum). Crit is rolled by castAbility only if the caster has ABILITY_CRIT (canCritByDefault is false). permanent = false: the board Pokemon is not changed. No expiry is coded in the strategy or in addAttack.

buffs.requested: 1 x baseAtk (9 for Meditite, 16 for Medicham)
buffs.applied: after AP scaling, crit, rounding, Big Eater Belt and the min-1 clamp

starBehavior.note: no star-indexed table in the code; the star count only matters through the unit's stat block (baseAtk). Medicham's higher atk gives a larger buff. The class atk values come from the unit blocks; the entity's baseAtk is read from the board Pokemon's atk at creation.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored mode. Each cast adds the buff again (cumulative); baseAtk is constant, so repeated casts do not compound on current attack, only on the fixed baseAtk.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: +1 x baseAtk. Requested +9 (Meditite) / +16 (Medicham). Applied = round(requested x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor), then Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down if held, added to the current atk with a floor of 1. At 0 AP and no crit and no belt: applied = requested.
